latest_news.title: Cargo vessel reports unknown-projectile hit near Strait of Hormuz

This reinforces existing active signals but does not justify raising the already extreme tracker score.

This weakens near-term deal optimism without creating a new canonical signal or changing the already extreme 94/100 raw/coupled score.

AFP local and security sources said the exchange ended later Saturday, but forces remain massed and the unresolved Sudan/Eritrea dimension leaves recurrence risk critical.

latest_news.headline: U.S.-Iran talks set for Monday as oil drops sharply on deal hopes
latest_news.summary: Reuters reports President Trump said negotiations would take place on 3 Aug with no deadline. Iran said Oman-mediated Strait-management talks were in their final stages but separated route negotiations from reopening. Brent fell more than 6% to about $82 in early trade; the local feed later showed $84.29, still 25.1% above its pre-conflict baseline.

dashboard_trackers.name: IRAN NUCLEAR
dashboard_trackers.notes: No current official reporting crossed a configured Iranian atomic-program threshold. Agency access uncertainty persists; direct Agency news and press endpoints were unavailable to the fallback collector, so official report indexes, UN material and reputable reporting were used. Raw/coupled risk holds 56/64

dashboard_trackers.name: IRAN WAR
dashboard_trackers.notes: Reuters reported only six vessels transited Hormuz on 3 Aug, down from seven the previous day, while a cargo vessel reported an unattributed projectile hit near Al Khasab. Conflicting U.S.-Iran accounts leave talks unverified and no sustained reopening is visible. Risk holds at 95 raw / 100 coupled

dashboard_trackers.name: ISRAEL-LEBANON
dashboard_trackers.notes: UNIFIL recorded 125 Israeli air violations from Thursday through Sunday, plus artillery events, engineering works and active troop movements. Rome talks were scheduled for 4 Aug, so diplomacy remains active, but no ceasefire recovery is verified. Risk holds 95 raw / 100 coupled

dashboard_trackers.name: TURKEY-NATO
dashboard_trackers.notes: Past-24h NATO, official and wire review found no direct Türkiye-alliance combat threshold or new missile/nuclear signal. Baseline risk holds at 5

dashboard_trackers.name: INDIA-PAKISTAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Past-24h wire and official review found no corroborated new India-Pakistan interstate combat threshold. A recycled low-quality headline about four Pakistani troops was traced to an old LoC incident and was not scored. Risk holds at 15

dashboard_trackers.name: PAKISTAN-AFGHANISTAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Past-24h regional, UN and wire review found no distinct new cross-border operational threshold. Existing diplomacy remains active and risk holds at 46

dashboard_trackers.name: RUSSIA-UKRAINE
dashboard_trackers.notes: The UN reported intensified urban and frontline attacks over the weekend, including at least nine killed and more than 30 injured in Kyiv on 1 Aug. Conventional-war risk remains at its 99 ceiling; no new nuclear-use or direct NATO-entry threshold was verified

dashboard_trackers.name: RUSSIA-NATO
dashboard_trackers.notes: The 30 Jul Russian missile impact in Poland remains the key allied-territory event. No Article 4/5 invocation or direct NATO-Russia exchange was found; reported U.S. destroyer/interceptor strain affects allied capacity but is not itself a combat threshold. Raw/coupled risk holds 70/80

dashboard_trackers.name: CHINA-TAIWAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Past-24h Taiwan and allied-source review found no new blockade or invasion threshold beyond already-priced military pressure. Raw/coupled risk holds 24/28

dashboard_trackers.name: DPRK
dashboard_trackers.notes: Past-24h KCNA, allied and wire review found no verified nuclear test or major missile-launch threshold. Risk holds at 18

dashboard_trackers.name: SUDAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: The UN reported a North Darfur drone strike causing dozens of casualties and renewed drone attacks around El Obeid that endangered civilians and aid operations. This confirms the extreme war baseline; risk holds at 94 because no distinct external-intervention threshold was verified

dashboard_trackers.name: ISRAEL PALESTINE
dashboard_trackers.notes: UN and 4 Aug reporting confirmed 26 weekend deaths in Gaza, destruction of medical supplies and the highest monthly 2026 fatality count in July. Hamas conditions disarmament on Israeli withdrawal while Israel conditions withdrawal on disarmament. Risk holds at 98

dashboard_trackers.name: SOUTH SUDAN ABYEI
dashboard_trackers.notes: Past-24h UN and wire review found no distinct Abyei or South Sudan threshold change. Risk holds at 19

dashboard_trackers.name: EASTERN DRC
dashboard_trackers.notes: The UN reported continuing South Kivu fighting and more than 48,000 people displaced in Uvira, Fizi and Mwenga since mid-July. This confirms severe active conflict; risk holds at 56 because no new interstate expansion threshold was independently verified

dashboard_trackers.name: YEMEN RED SEA
dashboard_trackers.notes: Houthi pressure on Saudi-linked shipping and attacks on tankers remain active. A Guardian planning report from Yemeni sources remains a watch item, but no launched al-Bayda operation was verified. Red Sea/Bab el-Mandeb risk holds at 100

dashboard_trackers.name: MALI SAHEL
dashboard_trackers.notes: BBC Verify confirmed that a sanctioned Russian ship delivered a large shipment of armoured and military vehicles for Malian and Russian forces, with the convoy seen in Bamako on 25 Jul amid rebel advances. This is fresh corroboration of external backing; raw/coupled risk rises 39→43

dashboard_trackers.name: SOUTH CHINA SEA
dashboard_trackers.notes: Chinese naval, air and coast-guard drills around Scarborough Shoal remain the key recent military-pressure event. No collision, boarding or armed exchange was reported; risk holds at 35

dashboard_trackers.name: SOMALIA GULF OF ADEN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Maritime and regional-source review found no new piracy or shipping-disruption threshold in the past 24h. Risk holds at 28

dashboard_trackers.name: SOUTHERN THAILAND
dashboard_trackers.notes: Regional review found no distinct new attack cluster or deployment threshold. Older insurgency and peace-talk reporting did not justify a new signal; risk holds at 30

dashboard_trackers.name: KUWAIT IRAQ BORDER
dashboard_trackers.notes: Kuwait reported destroying multiple Iranian drones and damage from debris/strikes at northern critical facilities and Bubiyan Island, without casualties. The existing infrastructure_strike signal is reinforced; risk holds at 30 pending casualties, penetration or retaliation

dashboard_trackers.name: IRAQ INTERNAL CONFLICT
dashboard_trackers.notes: U.S.-Saudi strikes on Iran-aligned groups and militia retaliation threats remain the key escalation evidence. No distinct post-cutoff widening was verified; risk holds at 40

dashboard_trackers.name: KENYA SOMALIA BORDER
dashboard_trackers.notes: The 29 Jul al-Shabaab ambush that killed five Kenyan security officers remains the key event. No further verified cross-border step change was found; risk holds at 25

dashboard_trackers.name: EGYPT MEDITERRANEAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: The 29 Jul drone-caused fire on two gas vessels at Damietta remains the key spillover event. Port operations resumed and no new strike was verified; risk holds at 20

dashboard_trackers.name: SPAIN MOROCCO CEUTA
dashboard_trackers.notes: Reuters/Al Jazeera reported five more bodies, lifting the confirmed Ceuta death toll to 72. More than 48,000 entrants returned to Morocco and conditions improved markedly, so risk holds at 22/elevated with a falling trend

dashboard_trackers.name: ETHIOPIA TIGRAY
dashboard_trackers.notes: The 1 Aug Shererina clash and earlier mobilization remain corroborated. On 4 Aug the TPLF alleged fresh federal deployments across Tigray, but this party claim lacked independent operational confirmation in the scan window. Existing force_mobilization is reconfirmed; risk holds at 32/critical
